items.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued May 20 at 7:09AM CDT until May 20 at 8:00AM CDT by NWS Brownsville TX
items.summary:
SVRBRO

The National Weather Service in Brownsville has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Central Cameron County in Deep South Texas...

* Until 800 AM CDT.

* At 708 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Holly Beach,
or near Laureles, moving south at 35 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Los Fresnos, South Padre Island, Rancho Viejo, Rio Hondo
